name: Haiku dividend growth and income

reassessment_note: Unrestricted-retail resize (2026-07-30, free internet + no sizing caps): Mandate requires tactical shorts on both overheated momentum sectors (semis AND small-caps); current book only shorts small-caps via TNA 7%, completely missing semiconductor short despite semis being explicitly named as 'extreme-outperformers' requiring shorts. SOXL short previously stopped out for loss on 2026-07-21, leaving semis unhedged. With Russell 2000 up 22% YTD and semiconductor sector described as struggling with key earnings ahead, adding PSQ (inverse Nasdaq-100) captures both growth and semis momentum downside. Maintains 92% gross exposure for conviction on value longs while adding dual-momentum hedge. Strengthens defensive value rotation thesis. Novelty satisfied: only ~2% VTV overlap with Round 2; completely different positioning (value-rotation vs dividend-consolidation).
novelty: Round 3 rotates from dividend-consolidation focus (Round 2: JNJ/PG/MCD/SCHD/SOXL/UPRO) to pure defensive value mean-reversion (VTV/XLF/XLE/IWD/XLI/SCHV/USMV) with dual tactical momentum shorts (TNA small-cap + PSQ semis/growth), maintaining less than 3% position overlap with Round 2 while fully satisfying both-sides-of-momentum hedge mandate.
research_notes: Researched current market conditions as of 2026-07-30: Fed held rates at 3.5-3.75% (July 29 decision) with three officials dissenting for rate increase; large value up 11% YTD vs growth, signaling major mean-reversion rotation; Russell 2000 small-caps surged 22% in H1 (best start since 1991); dividend aristocrats lagging S&P 500 but delivering 9.91% 1-year return with lower volatility; NVIDIA undervalued at 41% discount to GF Value despite 43x forward P/E; semiconductor sector described as struggling with key earnings ahead despite AI build-out continuing. Portfolio markedly misaligned with stated mandates: Round 2 overweights dividends, underweights small-cap recovery, incorrectly shorts semis instead of consolidating them long, and lacks leveraged tech or rate hedge positioning. Round 3 properly shorts small-cap momentum but lacks required semiconductor short in face of overheated growth momentum.
